title: cyperus nutans subsp. eleusinoides
intro: Cyperus nutans subsp. eleusinoides, commonly known as the Rice Paddy Blue Sedge, is a plant species native to tropical and subtropical regions. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. This plant is said to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, respiratory issues, and skin disorders. The bioactive constituents of Cyperus nutans subsp. eleusinoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
